recipe.visualDefinition: A profile portrait of a woman with a platinum blonde beehive hairstyle against a solid ochre background, featuring a two-tiered typographic header in contrasting red and green.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the lower right quadrant, looking upward and left.
Bold sans-serif title anchored at the top center.
Fluid script subtitle nested directly beneath the main title.
High-contrast color triad of mustard yellow, tomato red, and forest green.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the lower right, cropped at the shoulders, occupying approximately 40% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold red sans-serif text at the top serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red text, drop to the green script, and follow the subject's gaze from the bottom right back toward the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the upper left and center-left creates a sense of openness and focus on the subject's profile.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mustard/Ochre yellow background providing a warm, vintage base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Tomato red for the primary display text to ensure immediate legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Forest green for the secondary script text and silver/white for the jewelry highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text colors against a medium-value, slightly desaturated background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Uppercase sans-serif has uniform stroke weight and flat terminals.
Lowercase script features a heavy downstroke and connected, rhythmic flow.
Exclamation point in script style is oversized and tilted.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' in the sans-serif has a short hook.
The 'l' in the script has a prominent top loop.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, industrial sans-serif with a soft, organic brush script.
graphicDevices: Oversized exclamation mark as a focal point

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, flat-terminal sans-serif style.
Captures the mid-century casual script aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman in profile looking up and to the left, wearing a 1960s platinum blonde beehive hairstyle and dangling diamond earrings. The background is a solid, slightly textured mustard yellow wall. The lighting is soft and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered text at the top. The first line is a bold, condensed red sans-serif in all caps. The second line is a forest green brush script in lowercase, slightly tilted upwards.

verificationChecks: Is the subject in the lower right quadrant?
Are the text colors red and green?
Is the background a solid ochre/yellow?
Is the top text sans-serif and the bottom text script?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text is significantly larger than the green text.
Check that the subject's hair has a distinct 1960s volume.
Verify the background texture is subtle and not distracting.
Confirm the script text is lowercase.
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile Portrait + Solid Ochre Background + (Bold Red Sans-Serif / Green Brush Script) Header
